title: Bakuretsu Aishisugite Metsu! (Crazy Mashup by TeddyLoid)

alternative_titles.ja: M!LK -「爆裂愛しすぎて滅！(Crazy Mashup by TeddyLoid)」

synopsis:
Music video for the mashup song to two of M!LK's popular songs: "Sukisugite Metsu!" and "Bakuretsu Aishiteru". The song is mashed by TeddyLoid to commemorate Ii M!LK no Hi (Good M!LK Day).

The members are in their animal forms dancing to the mashup song.
